page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.2xlarge is an x86_64 compute-oriented instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. Built on a KVM hypervisor with dedicated CPU allocation, it features 4 physical cores supporting hyperthreading to provide 8 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Local storage is absent, and network baseline throughput is capped at 2 Gbps. Hardware vector extension capabilities include AVX-512 and AVX512_VNNI alongside AES cryptography acceleration.

Benchmark evaluations reveal average execution efficiency in synthetic multi-core workloads, reflected by a PassMark CPU score of 7018.44 and an extended instructions score of 6069.7. Uncached large-block memory read and write bandwidth reach 39.9 GB/sec and 32.58 GB/sec respectively. Single-core processing performance is limited, with Geekbench single-core scoring 996.0 and stress-ng single-core reaching 1106.2. High-density web serving throughput yields 5.94 GB/sec, while small 135M LLM inference generation reaches 116.45 tokens/sec.

With a dedicated vCPU allocation paired with a low 1.0 GB memory per core ratio, the server emphasizes compute core availability over memory capacity. This architectural profile provides qualitative cost efficiency for CPU-bound tasks that do not require high memory density per thread. The primary tradeoff is the strict 8.0 GB RAM limitation, which restricts application scale for memory-intensive databases or large cached datasets.
Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.2xlarge is suitable for lightweight multi-threaded batch jobs, software compilation, CI/CD runner pipelines, and utility compute tasks operating within a low memory footprint.
